primitives.name: Script Elasticity Coefficient
primitives.verbatim_quote: **script_elasticity.csv** — (season, team): M06 beta_script = plays-weighted OLS slope of early-down pass rate on WP bin center (10 bins); NaN when <4 non-empty bins.
primitives.assumptions: Linear relationship between win probability and early-down pass rate, weighted by play count.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Behavioral sensitivity to win probability in early-down scenarios.

layer2.mapping: Derived from GSI's kernel regression over win probability bins to estimate script responsiveness.
layer2.telemetry: Estimated pass rate elasticity against win probability bins.

primitives.name: First-Order Contrast
primitives.verbatim_quote: **sequencing.csv** — (season, team, down in (2,3)): M08 first-order contrast.
primitives.assumptions: Sequential dependency of play type following run success/failure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Strategic response to prior play outcome in 2nd and 3rd downs.

layer2.mapping: Computed as GSE's contrast kernel over sequential play outcomes to detect behavioral drift.
layer2.telemetry: Difference in pass rate after successful vs failed run plays.
